import asyncio

async def search_terms():
    results = await asyncio.gather(
        CONTEXT.search("It seems like I cannot"),
        CONTEXT.search("send"),
        CONTEXT.search("world.send"),
        CONTEXT.search("GIVE_UP"),
        CONTEXT.search("User"),
        CONTEXT.search("cannot interact"),
        CONTEXT.search("tool 5"),
        CONTEXT.search("tool 6"),
    )
    return results
